import BusyBeaver.ZFC.Permutation252Frame
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.BootPerm252
namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC
open RegisterPath FiniteZipper Permutation252Frame
#print axioms permutation_composition
#print axioms physOf_lt
#print axioms physicalOrder_inverse
#print axioms physOf_inverse
#print axioms physOf_injective
#print axioms vregs_length
#print axioms nth_vregs
#print axioms update_vregs
#print axioms nth_vregs_append
#print axioms update_vregs_append
#print axioms increment_vregs
#print axioms decrement_vregs
#print axioms tail_update
#print axioms vregs_zero
#print axioms zeroRoot_tail
#print axioms zeroRoot_dispatchZip
#print axioms frame_of_zeroRoot_zip
example (R : Registers) (spares : List Nat) :
    (vregs R ++ spares)[physOf 7]?.getD 0 = R 7 := nth_vregs_append R spares 7 (by decide)
example (R : Registers) (spares : List Nat) (v : Nat) :
    writeRegisters (vregs R ++ spares) (physOf 8) v = vregs (update R 8 v) ++ spares :=
  update_vregs_append R spares 8 v (by decide)
example : dispatchZip (⟨94, by decide⟩ : Fin 252) 2 10 1 zeroRoot 40
    BootPerm252.bootSparesPerm252 = BootPerm252.bootTargetPerm252 := by decide +kernel
example : DispatchFrame (⟨94, by decide⟩ : Fin 252) (machinePerm252.run 82552)
    zeroRoot 40 BootPerm252.bootSparesPerm252 := by
  apply frame_of_zeroRoot_zip _ _ _ _ (by decide) 10 1
  rw [BootPerm252.fullBootstrapPerm252_head]
  have hz : dispatchZip (⟨94, by decide⟩ : Fin 252) 2 10 1 zeroRoot 40
      BootPerm252.bootSparesPerm252 = BootPerm252.bootTargetPerm252 := by decide +kernel
  rw [hz]
  exact BootPerm252.fullBootstrapPerm252
end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC
